name: Whirlpool Filtration DW Diverter Motor (P6-4 & P6-6)
failureModes: Open winding — F9E1 / spray zone faults
Good ohms but no rotation — control TRIAC or door switch
testingTips: Measure at P6-4 and P6-6 with P6 unplugged from ACU
Confirm diverter disk installed before live Service Diagnostics test

name: Whirlpool Filtration DW DC Fan Motor (P14)
purpose: ProDry DC fan — W11480208 §3-20; live test expects 13 VDC ±5%.
failureModes: Open winding — F10E3 / vent dry complaints
Good ohms but no spin — control DC drive
testingTips: Fan runs during Service Diagnostics step 4 on fan-equipped models
Do not confuse with legacy 31–41 kΩ fan spec (W11633848 platform)

name: Whirlpool Filtration DW Variable-Speed Wash Motor
purpose: Variable-speed wash motor — W11480208 §3-17 (P5-1 & P5-2). No AC bench run test.
failureModes: Open winding — wash motor fault with VSM platform
Good ohms — verify sump/filter; motor uses DC drive (no 120 VAC bench check)
testingTips: SSM models use 7–12 Ω on same pins — use w11633848-wash-motor for single-speed
Error code present when VSM fails; confirm motor type from tech sheet

name: Whirlpool Filtration DW VSM Drain Motor (P5-5 & P5-6)
purpose: Drain motor on variable-speed wash platforms — W11480208 §3-19.
failureModes: Open winding — won't drain on VSM models
SSM drain uses P5-3 & P5-4 (27–33 Ω) — see w11633848-drain-motor
testingTips: Check hose, disposal plug, and check valve before motor replacement
Intermittent lock-up — verify axial play at pump
